name: Mother Puckers | 200mg Live Rosin Gummies | Nighty Night Mixed Fruit (2:1:1 THC:CBN:CBD)
description:
Sleep Tight. Stay Puck’d.

Nighty Night is your new lights-out legend—infused with a knockout blend of 200mg THC, 100mg CBN, and 100mg CBD. Whether you're chasing REM or just trying to finally chill, this Supercharged Super Sour Chew is formulated for total body relaxation, deep sleep, and restorative nighttime recovery.

Each pouch packs five distinct fruit flavors—Orange, Watermelon, Blue Raspberry, Black Cherry, and Green Apple—each coated in our signature sour sugar and followed by a sweet, juicy finish.

No flavor blends. No filler. Just full-send fruit for bedtime. Crafted with premium Live Rosin for full-spectrum terpene-rich effects, Nighty Night delivers calming Indica energy with powerful minor cannabinoids to help you wind down, reset, and actually rest. Sleep doesn’t have to be boring. And neither should your edible.

Loud flavors. Loud effects. Loud brand. Vegan, gluten-free, heat-resistant. #PAFO
